limits: One fresh process per model with warm OS file cache. Background scheduling and other authoring activity were uncontrolled.
Measured component: animation advance and forced bone transforms, not GPU skinning, rendering or whole-game frame time.
The Ground Pound median increased from12.8125 to16.2508 microseconds in these snapshots; Walk varied in the opposite direction. Do not treat these two runs as an isolated causal benchmark.
Retained static allocation includes first-actor scene/library/mesh/texture caches, not per-instance memory or total VRAM.
The candidate intentionally changes right-arm motion; this is a repair-cost measurement, not an animation-equivalence result.
